SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我就知道您会选我准备的饭
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我就知道您會選我準備的飯
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私を選んでくれると思ってました。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku tahu kamu bakal pilih itu!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu sabia que você ia escolher isso!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Я знала, что ты выберешь это!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Je savais que tu choisirais ça !
SCRIPT.THAI: ฉันรู้ว่าเธอต้องเลือกอันนี้!
หลังจากเธอทำเสร็จ

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you want to talk with me?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私と話しに行きませんか？
SCRIPT.THAI: เธออยากคุยกับฉันไหม?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But I need to talk with him too...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私も、お兄ちゃんと話したいんですけど…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi aku juga perlu bicara sama dia...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas eu também preciso falar com ele...
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Но мне тоже нужно с ним поговорить...
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Mais moi aussi, je dois lui parler...
SCRIPT.THAI: แต่ฉันก็มีเรื่องต้องคุยกับเขาเหมือนกัน...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Then you should have asked first.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ああ、私が先に話したかったんですけど…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau gitu, kamu harusnya minta duluan.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então você devia ter pedido primeiro.
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Тогда тебе надо было спросить первой.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Alors tu aurais dû demander en premier.
SCRIPT.THAI: งั้นเธอก็ควรจะขอคุยก่อนสิ

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Did you think about the people waiting?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那也要考虑一下其他人吧?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那也要考慮一下其他人吧?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 待ってる人のこと、考えないんですか?
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apa kamu nggak mikirin orang yang lagi nunggu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você pensou nas pessoas que estão esperando?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Ты думала о людях, которые ждут?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Tu as pensé aux personnes qui attendent ?
SCRIPT.THAI: เธอคิดถึงคนที่รออยู่บ้างไหม?

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 자기 멋대로 그렇게 채가는 게 어딨어요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You can’t just take him like that.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 怎么能随心所欲地抢走他呢
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 怎麼能隨心所欲地搶走他呢
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 勝手に連れて行くのは、どうかと思いますけど。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu gak bisa ambil dia gitu aja.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você não pode simplesmente levar ele assim.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Tu ne peux pas juste l’emmener comme ça.
SCRIPT.THAI: เธอจะพาเขาไปแบบนั้นไม่ได้

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあ、ユマンが決めてよ！
SCRIPT.THAI: งั้น ยูมัน เธอต้องตัดสินใจเอง!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Who are you going to talk to first?
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu mau bicara sama siapa dulu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Com quem você vai falar primeiro?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: С кем ты будешь говорить первым?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: À qui tu vas parler en premier ?
SCRIPT.THAI: เธอจะคุยกับใครก่อน?
